techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.developer: Embassy Group / Embassy Office Parks REIT
techParks.description: Large business park on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli; Flipkart's group HQ occupies the bridge-linked Alyssa, Begonia and Clover buildings (also the registered office of Myntra and Instakart), and Swiggy's listed company is still registered in the I & J block although its head office moved to Whitefield in 2026.

techParks.name: Embassy Tech Square
techParks.description: Office campus on the Marathahalli-Sarjapur Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, made up of named blocks (Alpha, Delta, Omega and others); InMobi's corporate office and Glance occupy Delta Block and LeadSquared the Omega block. OSM has no campus polygon, so the point is between the mapped InMobi building and the Omega POI.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Large multi-block tech park on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli whose blocks carry planet and element names (Valence, Electra, Jupiter and others); CoinSwitch's operating LLP is registered at the Awfis centre in Valence and OSM pins a CoinSwitch office in Electra.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.locality: Bellandur (Green Glen Layout, Outer Ring Road)
techParks.description: Office complex at the Sarjapur Road - Outer Ring Road junction, Bellandur; every PhonePe group company is registered in Block A (Wings A and B, floors 3-7).

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Two-tower office campus on Sarjapur Main Road at Ambalipura; Groww's listed parent and every Groww subsidiary are registered in the South Tower, and ShareChat (Mohalla Tech) in the Smartworks centre in the North Tower.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Square
techParks.description: Single office building at Iblur near the Sarjapur Road - ORR junction; Navi Ltd is registered on its 9th floor and OSM pins a Navi office inside it.

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.description: Office complex on the Outer Ring Road near Sakra World Hospital, Bellandur, now branded Spatium Commercio; Rapido's corporate office and VerSe Innovation (Dailyhunt, Josh) are both in Tower A.

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
techParks.description: Business park on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli (Chandana bus stop); Meesho's listed company is registered in Wing E and Ninjacart in IndiQube's Tower E.

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: Multi-tower tech park on Sarjapur Road at Carmelaram; Open Financial Technologies is registered on the 3rd floor of Tower 2.

techParks.name: Diamond District

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park

techParks.name: SJR Primeco The Hub

coverageNotes: SCOPE: 63 companies, 89 offices, 28 parks. The lens is Bengaluru-headquartered unicorns and former unicorns, plus the non-unicorn names the brief listed (Myntra, Practo, BlueStone, Navi, Khatabook, Simpl, Ninjacart, Bounce, Dunzo, Gameskraft, Whatfix, MoEngage). isUnicorn means the company reached a $1 bn valuation at some point. Former unicorns (Byju's, Quikr, Mu Sigma) are true, and the description says 'former'. Myntra is false: it was bought by Flipkart in 2014 before reaching $1 bn. Pocket FM (about $750 m in its 2024 Series D), BlueStone (listed just under $1 bn), Gameskraft (some trackers list it, but no priced round supports it), Whatfix and MoEngage are false because I could not establish a $1 bn round. Navi, Khatabook, Simpl, Ninjacart, Bounce, Dunzo and Practo were never unicorns. METHOD AND LIMITS: the shared WebSearch budget (200 per turn) was already used up when this lens started, so I made no web searches. In particular, the unicorn list for 2025-2026 could not be checked against Tracxn, Venture Intelligence or Inc42: the Inc42 tracker returned 404, Tracxn returned 403, and Wikipedia was rate-limited. The list comes from my own knowledge (2025 additions included: Juspay, Jumbotail, Netradyne) and any 2026 unicorn is missing. Addresses were therefore verified primarily against the GLEIF LEI registry API, which gives each Indian entity's MCA-validated legal and headquarters address with a renewal date in 2025-2026 (cited as search.gleif.org record links). I also fetched company pages directly: Swiggy corporate, InMobi, Zerodha and Practo contact pages, Go Digit contact, the Rapido contact page, the verse.in and slice.bank.in footers, apna contact, the cult.fit privacy policy, Mu Sigma contact, brndme.in and Livspace about. OSM POIs from osm-offices.json supplied building points and some secondary offices. Offices evidenced only by an OSM POI are marked low. A few evidence sentences cite another lens's earlier fetch of a company page (marked 'cited by lens E08/G10/G11') together with the LEI record, which I verified myself. LEFT OUT, NO BENGALURU ADDRESS COULD BE SUBSTANTIATED: Hasura (HQ San Francisco; its pages now redirect to PromptQL and list no India address), Drools (LEI registered in Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh; its site returned 503), and Jupiter / Amica Financial (LEI and contact page give only Mumbai; the OSM 'Jupiter' on the ORR is a Prestige Tech Park block name). Quess Corp was left to lens E05 because it is a listed MNC, not a startup. LEFT OUT, OUT OF LENS: per the brief, Infra.Market, Darwinbox, Chargebee, Freshworks, Mindtickle, Spinny, Mamaearth, Lenskart and Nykaa. I also excluded Polygon (Mumbai-founded, HQ abroad), Cleartrip (now registered in Mumbai; Flipkart subsidiary), and Bengaluru near-unicorns such as Shadowfax, KreditBee, Fi, Uni, Sarvam AI and Ultrahuman, which E08/E09/G11 cover. LEFT OUT, OUTSIDE THE METRO BOX: Ola Electric's Futurefactory and cell gigafactory (Krishnagiri) and Ather's Hosur factory. OPEN QUESTIONS: (1) Swiggy moved its head office to Sumadhura Capitol Towers, Whitefield, in 2026, but its listed company is still registered at Embassy TechVillage; how much ETV space it keeps is unknown. (2) Cult.fit Ltd is now registered in Chennai; its Bengaluru HSR address comes from its privacy policy. (3) The Livspace, Zeta, DealShare and Quikr locations are low confidence. Livspace and Apna are registered in Gurugram, Zeta's Indian entity in Mumbai, DealShare's in Jaipur, and Quikr's LEI lapsed in 2022. (4) OSM-only secondary offices may be historical: Flipkart at Mantri Commercio and Trifecta Adatto, PhonePe at Aurbis, Myntra at Sattva Eminence, CRED aqua, Unacademy at EGL, Ola at Regent Insignia, CoinSwitch in Electra, NoBroker at Kaikondrahalli, and Bounce. Myntra's former AKR Tech Park / Kudlu Gate HQ, which it left around 2020, is not included because the move predates 2023. Byju's Kalyani Tech Park office is included as closed because Byju's vacated its non-HQ offices in 2024. Dunzo is included as closed; it shut in January 2025. No Bengaluru headcounts are given: I found none that a source states as a Bengaluru-specific number.
